rules.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
rules.description: Attacker-controlled object keys modify Object prototype attributes.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rules.description: Modifying an object obtained via a user-controlled property name may lead to accidental mutation of the built-in Object prototype, and possibly escalate to remote code execution or cross-site scripting.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Type Conversion or Cast
rules.description: An attempt to use a value that is not an object or 'null' as a prototype will either be ignored or result in a runtime error.

rules.cwe_name: NULL Pointer Dereference
rules.description: Trying to invoke a value that is not a function will result in a runtime exception.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrect Number of Arguments
rules.description: A function is invoked with extra trailing arguments that are ignored.

rules.cwe_name: Use of Cryptographically Weak Pseudo-Random Number Generator (PRNG)
rules.description: Using a cryptographically weak pseudo-random number generator to generate a security-sensitive value may allow an attacker to predict what value will be generated.

rules.cwe_name: Use of Potentially Dangerous Function
rules.description: The 'eval' function and the 'Function' constructor execute strings as code. This is dangerous and impedes program analysis and understanding. Consequently, these two functions should not be used.

rules.cwe_name: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
rules.description: Allowing writes to arbitrary properties of an object may lead to denial-of-service attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Inconsistent Interpretation of HTTP Requests ('HTTP Request/Response Smuggling')
rules.description: Using an insecure http parser can lead to http smuggling attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Creation of Temporary File With Insecure Permissions
rules.description: Creating a temporary file that is accessible by other users can lead to information disclosure and sometimes remote code execution.

rules.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
rules.description: Attacker-controlled object keys modify Object prototype attributes.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rules.description: Functions recursively assigning properties on objects may be the cause of accidental modification of a built-in prototype object.

rules.cwe_name: Assignment to Variable without Use
rules.description: If an object literal has two properties with the same name, the second property overwrites the first one, which makes the code hard to understand and error-prone.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Type Conversion or Cast
rules.description: Assigning to a property of a primitive value has no effect and may trigger a runtime error.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrect Number of Arguments
rules.description: A function is invoked with extra trailing arguments that are ignored.

rules.cwe_name: NULL Pointer Dereference
rules.description: Trying to invoke a value that is not a function will result in a runtime exception.

rules.cwe_name: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
rules.description: Allowing writes to arbitrary properties of an object may lead to denial-of-service attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
rules.description: Using cookies without CSRF protection may allow malicious websites to submit requests on behalf of the user.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: Replacing a substring with itself has no effect and may indicate a mistake.

rules.cwe_name: Excessive Iteration
rules.description: Iterating over an object with a user-controlled .length property can cause indefinite looping.
